verses.en: And Adam hearkened unto the voice of God, and called upon his sons to repent.
verses.sm: Ma sa faalogo Atamu i le siufofoga o le Atua, ma sa valaau atu i ona atalii ia salamo.

verses.en: And Adam knew his wife again, and she bare a son, and he called his name Seth. And Adam glorified the name of God; for he said: God hath appointed me another seed, instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.
verses.sm: Ma sa toe iloa e Atamu lana ava, ma sa fanauina e ia se atalii, ma sa ta’ua e Atamu lona igoa o Setu. Ma sa viia e Atamu le suafa o le Atua; ona sa fai mai o ia: Ua tofia mai e le Atua ia te a’u se tasi atalii, i le tulaga o Apelu, o lē na fasiotia e Kaino.

verses.en: And God revealed himself unto Seth, and he rebelled not, but offered an acceptable sacrifice, like unto his brother Abel. And to him also was born a son, and he called his name Enos.
verses.sm: Ma sa faaali mai e le Atua o ia lava ia Setu, ma sa lē fouvale o ia, ae sa tuuina atu e ia se taulaga na talia, e pei o lona uso o Apelu. Ma sa fanau mai foi ia te ia se atalii, ma sa ta’ua e ia lona igoa o Enosa.

verses.en: And then began these men to call upon the name of the Lord, and the Lord blessed them;
verses.sm: Ma ona amata lea ona valaau atu o nei alii i le suafa o le Alii, ma sa faamanuiaina i latou e le Alii;

verses.en: And a book of remembrance was kept, in the which was recorded, in the language of Adam, for it was given unto as many as called upon God to write by the spirit of inspiration;
verses.sm: Ma sa tausia se tusi faamanatu, lea sa tusia ai i le gagana a Atamu, ona sa tuuina mai i le toatele na valaau atu i le Atua e tusitusi e ala i le agaga o musumusuga;

verses.en: And by them their children were taught to read and write, having a language which was pure and undefiled.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou na aoaoina a latou fanau e faitau ma tusitusi, i se gagana na mamā ma lē eleelea.

verses.en: Now this same Priesthood, which was in the beginning, shall be in the end of the world also.
verses.sm: O lenei o lea lava Perisitua, lea sa i ai i le amataga, o le a i ai foi i le iuga o le lalolagi.

verses.en: Now this prophecy Adam spake, as he was moved upon by the Holy Ghost, and a genealogy was kept of the children of God. And this was the book of the generations of Adam, saying: In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
verses.sm: Ma o le valoaga lenei na fofogaina e Atamu, a’o uunaia o ia e le Agaga Paia, ma sa tausia se gafa o le fanau a le Atua. Ma o le tusi lenei o augatupulaga a Atamu, ua fai mai: I le aso na foafoa ai e le Atua le tagata, na faia ai e ia o ia i le faatusa o le Atua;

verses.en: In the image of his own body, male and female, created he them, and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created and became living souls in the land upon the footstool of God.
verses.sm: O le faatusa o lona lava tino, o le tane ma le fafine, na foafoa ai e ia i laua, ma faamanuia ia te i laua, ma ta’ua lo laua igoa o Atamu, i le aso na foafoa ai i laua ma avea ai ma tagata ola i le laueleele o le tuuaao o le Atua.

verses.en: And Adam lived one hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his own image, and called his name Seth.
verses.sm: Ma sa ola Atamu i le selau tolugafulu o tausaga, ma fanaua se atalii i lona lava faatusa, i ona lava foliga, ma ta’ua lona igoa o Setu.

verses.en: And the days of Adam, after he had begotten Seth, were eight hundred years, and he begat many sons and daughters;
verses.sm: Ma o aso o Atamu, ina ua uma ona fanaua e ia o Setu, e valu selau tausaga, ma sa fanaua e ia atalii ma afafine e toatele;

verses.en: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years, and he died.
verses.sm: Ma o aso uma na ola ai Atamu e iva selau ma le tolusefulu tausaga, ma sa maliu o ia.

verses.en: Seth lived one hundred and five years, and begat Enos, and prophesied in all his days, and taught his son Enos in the ways of God; wherefore Enos prophesied also.
verses.sm: Sa ola Setu i le selau ma le lima o tausaga, ma fanaua Enosa, ma sa vavalo i ona aso uma, ma aoao i lona atalii o Enosa ala o le Atua; o le mea lea na vavalo ai foi Enosa.

verses.en: And Seth lived, after he begat Enos, eight hundred and seven years, and begat many sons and daughters.
verses.sm: Ma sa ola Setu, ina ua uma ona fanaua e ia Enosa, i tausaga e valu selau ma le fitu, ma fanaua ni atalii ma afafine e toatele.

verses.en: And the children of men were numerous upon all the face of the land. And in those days Satan had great dominion among men, and raged in their hearts; and from thenceforth came wars and bloodshed; and a man's hand was against his own brother, in administering death, because of secret works, seeking for power.
verses.sm: Ma sa toatele le fanauga a tagata i le laueleele atoa. Ma i aso na sa i ai se puleaga tele a Satani i totonu o tagata, ma sa sasao i o latou loto; ma mai le taimi lena ma le agai i luma na oo mai ai taua ma le faamasaatoto; ma sa sii atu le lima o le tagata faasaga i lona lava uso, e fasioti, ona o galuega faalilolilo, i le sailiga o le pule.

verses.en: All the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years, and he died.
verses.sm: O aso uma o Setu e iva selau ma le sefululua tausaga, ma sa maliu o ia.

verses.en: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan. And Enos and the residue of the people of God came out from the land, which was called Shulon, and dwelt in a land of promise, which he called after his own son, whom he had named Cainan.
verses.sm: Ma sa ola Enosa i tausaga e ivasefulu, ma fanaua Kainano. Ma o Enosa ma e na totoe o le nuu o le Atua na o ese mai i le laueleele, lea sa ta’ua o Sulona, ma nonofo i se laueleele o le folafolaga, lea sa ta’ua e ia i le igoa o lona lava atalii, o lē na faaigoa e ia o Kainano.

verses.en: And Enos lived, after he begat Cainan, eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat many sons and daughters. And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years, and he died.
verses.sm: Ma sa ola Enosa, ina ua uma ona fanaua e ia Kainano, i tausaga e valu selau ma le sefululima, ma fanaua ni atalii ma afafine e toatele. Ma o aso uma o Enosa, e iva selau ma le lima tausaga, ma sa maliu o ia.

verses.en: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel; and Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters. And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years, and he died.
verses.sm: Ma sa ola Kainano i tausaga e fitusefulu, ma fanaua Maalaelu; ma sa ola Kainano ina ua uma ona fanaua e ia Maalaelu, i tausaga e valu selau fagafulu, ma fanaua atalii ma afafine. Ma o aso uma o Kainano e iva selau ma le sefulu tausaga, ma sa maliu o ia.

verses.en: And Mahalaleel lived sixty-five years, and begat Jared; and Mahalaleel lived, after he begat Jared, eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters. And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred and ninety-five years, and he died.
verses.sm: Ma sa ola Maalaelu i tausaga e onosefulu ma le lima, ma fanaua Iareto; ma sa ola Maalaelu, ina ua uma ona fanaua e ia Iareto, i tausaga e valu selau ma le tolusefulu, ma fanaua atalii ma afafine. Ma o aso uma o Maalaelu e valu selau ma le ivasefulu-lima tausaga, ma sa maliu o ia.

verses.en: And Jared lived one hundred and sixty-two years, and begat Enoch; and Jared lived, after he begat Enoch, eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters. And Jared taught Enoch in all the ways of God.
verses.sm: Ma sa ola Iareto i tausaga e selau onosefulu-lua, ma fanaua Enoka; ma sa ola Iareto, ina ua uma ona fanaua e ia Enoka, i tausaga e valu selau, ma fanaua atalii ma afafine. Ma sa aoao e Iareto ia Enoka i ala uma o le Atua.

verses.en: And this is the genealogy of the sons of Adam, who was the son of God, with whom God, himself, conversed.
verses.sm: Ma o le gafa lenei o atalii o Atamu, o lē o le atalii o le Atua, o lē na fetautalatalaai ma le Atua lava ia.

verses.en: And they were preachers of righteousness, and spake and prophesied, and called upon all men, everywhere, to repent; and faith was taught unto the children of men.
verses.sm: Ma sa o ni tagata talai o le amiotonu i latou, ma sa tautatala ma vavalo atu, ma valaau atu i tagata uma, i soo se mea lava, ia salamo; ma sa aoao atu le faatuatua i le fanauga a tagata.

verses.en: And it came to pass that all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years, and he died.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina o aso uma o Iareto e iva selau ma le onosefulu-lua tausaga, ma sa maliu o ia.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And Enoch lived sixty-five years, and begat Methuselah.
verses.sm: Ma sa ola Enoka i tausaga e onosefulu-lima, ma fanaua ai Metusela.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Enoch journeyed in the land, among the people; and as he journeyed, the Spirit of God descended out of heaven, and abode upon him.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina malaga atu Enoka i le laueleele, i totonu o le nuu; ma a’o malaga atu o ia, sa afio ifo le Agaga o le Atua mai le lagi, ma afio i ona luga.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And he heard a voice from heaven, saying: Enoch, my son, prophesy unto this people, and say unto them—Repent, for thus saith the Lord: I am angry with this people, and my fierce anger is kindled against them; for their hearts have waxed hard, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes cannot see afar off;
verses.sm: Ma sa faalogoina e ia se leo mai le lagi, ua fetalai mai: Enoka, lo’u atalii e, vavalo atu i lenei nuu, ma fai atu ia te i latou— Ia salamo, ona ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii: Ua Ou ita i lenei nuu, ma ua sasao a’e lo’u ita tele e faasaga ia te i latou; ona ua faasolo ina malo o latou loto, ma ua feū o latou taliga e faalogo, ma ua lē mafai ona vaai mamao o latou mata;

verses.en: And for these many generations, ever since the day that I created them, have they gone astray, and have denied me, and have sought their own counsels in the dark; and in their own abominations have they devised murder, and have not kept the commandments, which I gave unto their father, Adam.
verses.sm: Ma i le tele o nei augatupulaga, talu mai lava le aso na Ou foafoaina ai i latou, ua latou o sese ai, ma teena a’u, ma latou saili ai a latou lava taupulepulega i le pouliuli; ma ua latou fuafuaina le fasioti tagata i a latou lava mea inosia, ma ua latou lē tausia poloaiga, ia sa Ou tuu atu i lo latou tamā, o Atamu.

verses.en: Wherefore, they have foresworn themselves, and, by their oaths, they have brought upon themselves death; and a hell I have prepared for them, if they repent not;
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ua latou molimau pepelo ai i latou lava, ma, ua latou aumai i luga o i latou lava, ia latou tautoga le oti; ma ua Ou saunia se seoli mo i latou, pe afai latou te lē salamo;

verses.en: And this is a decree, which I have sent forth in the beginning of the world, from my own mouth, from the foundation thereof, and by the mouths of my servants, thy fathers, have I decreed it, even as it shall be sent forth in the world, unto the ends thereof.
verses.sm: Ma o se tulafono lenei, mai lo’u lava gutu, sa Ou auina atu i le amataga o le lalolagi, mai lona faavaega, ma o fofoga o a’u auauna, ou tamā, na Ou poloaiina ai, e pei lava ona o le a auina atu i le lalolagi, seia oo atu i ona tuluiga.

verses.en: And when Enoch had heard these words, he bowed himself to the earth, before the Lord, and spake before the Lord, saying: Why is it that I have found favor in thy sight, and am but a lad, and all the people hate me; for I am slow of speech; wherefore am I thy servant?
verses.sm: Ma ina ua faalogo Enoka i nei upu, sa ifo o ia lava i le eleele, i luma o le Alii, ma tautala atu i luma o le Alii, ua fai atu: Aisea ua amanaia ai a’u i lau silafaga, ma o a’u ua na’o se tama, ma ua inoino mai tagata uma ia te a’u; ona e gese la’u tautala; o lea, aisea ua avea ai a’u ma au auauna?

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Enoch: Go forth and do as I have commanded thee, and no man shall pierce thee. Open thy mouth, and it shall be filled, and I will give thee utterance, for all flesh is in my hands, and I will do as seemeth me good.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia Enoka: Alu atu ma fai e pei ona Ou poloaiina ai oe, ma e leai se tagata o le a atia oe. Tatala lou gutu, ma o le a faatumuina, ma o le a Ou tuu atu ia te oe upu e te tautala ai, aua ua i o’u lima tagata uma, ma o le a Ou faia e tusa ai ma le lelei ia te a’u.

verses.en: Say unto this people: Choose ye this day, to serve the Lord God who made you.
verses.sm: Fai atu i lenei nuu: Ia outou filifili i le aso nei, e auauna atu i le Alii le Atua o lē na faia outou.

verses.en: Behold my Spirit is upon you, wherefore all thy words will I justify; and the mountains shall flee before you, and the rivers shall turn from their course; and thou shalt abide in me, and I in you; therefore walk with me.
verses.sm: Faauta ua i ou luga lo’u Agaga, o le mea lea o au upu uma o le a Ou ta’utonuina; ma o le a sosola mauga ai ou luma, ma o le a liliu vaitafe mai i o latou alātafe; ma o le a mau oe ia te a’u, ma a’u ia te oe; o lea, savali faatasi ma a’u.

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Enoch, and said unto him: Anoint thine eyes with clay, and wash them, and thou shalt see. And he did so.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia Enoka, ma fai mai ia te ia: Ia nini ou mata i le palapala, ma fufulu lea, ma o le a mafai ona e vaai. Ma sa faapea ona faia e ia.

verses.en: And he beheld the spirits that God had created; and he beheld also things which were not visible to the natural eye; and from thenceforth came the saying abroad in the land: A seer hath the Lord raised up unto his people.
verses.sm: Ma sa vaai o ia i agaga na foafoaina e le Atua; ma sa vaai foi o ia i mea sa lē vaaia e mata faalenatura; ma mai i le taimi lena ma le agai i luma na oo mai ai le tala faalauaitele i le laueleele: Ua faatuina a’e e le Alii se tagatavāai i lona nuu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Enoch went forth in the land, among the people, standing upon the hills and the high places, and cried with a loud voice, testifying against their works; and all men were offended because of him.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina alu atu Enoka i le laueleele, i totonu o le nuu, ua tu i luga o maupuepue ma mea maualuluga, ma alaga atu ma le leo tele, ua molimau atu e faasaga ia latou galuega; ma sa tausuai tagata uma ona o ia.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And they came forth to hear him, upon the high places, saying unto the tent-keepers: Tarry ye here and keep the tents, while we go yonder to behold the seer, for he prophesieth, and there is a strange thing in the land; a wild man hath come among us.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou o mai e faalogologo ia te ia, i luga o mea maualuluga, ua fai atu i e e tausi-faleie: Ia outou nonofo iinei ma vaavaai faleie, a’o matou o i ’o e vaavaai i le tagatavāai, ona ua vavalo o ia, ma ua i ai se mea uiga ese i le laueleele; ua sau se tagata valevale i totonu o i tatou.

verses.en: And it came to pass when they heard him, no man laid hands on him; for fear came on all them that heard him; for he walked with God.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua latou faalogo atu ia te ia, sa leai se tagata na faaoo atu lima ia te ia; ona sa oo mai le mata’u ia i latou uma o e na faalogo atu ia te ia; aua sa savavali o ia faatasi ma le Atua.

verses.en: And there came a man unto him, whose name was Mahijah, and said unto him: Tell us plainly who thou art, and from whence thou comest?
verses.sm: Ma sa sau se tagata ia te ia, o lona igoa o Maaisa, ma fai mai ia te ia: Ta’u manino mai ia i matou po o ai oe, ma le mea e te sau ai?

verses.en: And he said unto them: I came out from the land of Cainan, the land of my fathers, a land of righteousness unto this day. And my father taught me in all the ways of God.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu o ia ia te i latou: Na ou aluese mai le laueleele o Kainano, o le laueleele o o’u tamā, o se laueleele o le amiotonu e oo mai i le aso nei. Ma sa aoaoina a’u e lo’u tamā i ala uma o le Atua.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as I journeyed from the land of Cainan, by the sea east, I beheld a vision; and lo, the heavens I saw, and the Lord spake with me, and gave me commandment; wherefore, for this cause, to keep the commandment, I speak forth these words.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina a’o ou malaga mai le laueleele o Kainano, i tafatafa o le sami i sasae, sa ou vaaia se faaaliga vaaia; ma faauta, sa ou vaai i le lagi, ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia te au, ma tuu mai ia te au se poloaiga; o le mea lea, ona o le pogai lenei, ia tausia le poloaiga, ua ou tautala atu ai nei upu.

w.en: by the side of the sea

verses.en: And Enoch continued his speech, saying: The Lord which spake with me, the same is the God of heaven, and he is my God, and your God, and ye are my brethren, and why counsel ye yourselves, and deny the God of heaven?
verses.sm: Ma sa faaauau e Enoka lana lauga, ua faapea atu: O le Alii o lē na fetalai mai ia te au, o lea lava o le Atua o le lagi, ma o ia o lo’u Atua, ma lo outou Atua, ma o outou o o’u uso, ma aisea ua outou taupulepule ai ia te outou lava, ma faafitia le Atua o le lagi?

verses.en: The heavens he made; the earth is his footstool; and the foundation thereof is his. Behold, he laid it, an host of men hath he brought in upon the face thereof.
verses.sm: O le lagi na faia e ia; o le lalolagi o lona tuuaao; ma o lona faavae o lana lava. Faauta, o ia na faataotoina, na ia aumai i ona luga se ’au o tagata e toatele.

verses.en: And death hath come upon our fathers; nevertheless we know them, and cannot deny, and even the first of all we know, even Adam.
verses.sm: Ma ua oo mai le oti i luga o o tatou tamā; ae ui i lea, ua tatou iloa i latou, ma lē mafai ona faafitia, ma e oo lava i lē ua muamua i tagata uma ua tatou iloa, o Atamu lava.

verses.en: For a book of remembrance we have written among us, according to the pattern given by the finger of God; and it is given in our own language.
verses.sm: Ona ua tatou tusia i totonu o i tatou se tusi faamanatu, e tusa ma le ata na tuu mai e le tamatamaiaao o le Atua; ma sa tuuina mai i la tatou lava gagana.

verses.en: And as Enoch spake forth the words of God, the people trembled, and could not stand in his presence.
verses.sm: Ma a’o fetalai atu e Enoka afioga a le Atua, sa gatete tagata, ma lē mafai ona tutulai i ona luma.

verses.en: And he said unto them: Because that Adam fell, we are; and by his fall came death; and we are made partakers of misery and woe.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu o ia ia te i latou: Ona sa pa’ū Atamu, ua tatou i ai; ma o lona pa’ū ua oo mai ai le oti; ma ua oo mai ai ia i tatou le pagatia ma le malaia.

verses.en: Behold Satan hath come among the children of men, and tempteth them to worship him; and men have become carnal, sensual, and devilish, and are shut out from the presence of God.
verses.sm: Faauta ua sau Satani i totonu o le fanauga a tagata, ma faaosooso i latou e ifo atu ia te ia; ma ua avea ai tagata ua faaletino, faalelagona, ma faaletiapolo, ma ua tapunia ese mai luma o le Atua.

verses.en: But God hath made known unto our fathers that all men must repent.
verses.sm: Peitai sa faailoa mai e le Atua i o tatou tamā e ao i tagata uma ona salamo.

verses.en: And he called upon our father Adam by his own voice, saying: I am God; I made the world, and men before they were in the flesh.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai o ia i lo tatou tamā o Atamu i lona lava siufofoga, ua faapea mai: O A’u o le Atua; o A’u na faia le lalolagi, ma tagata a o lei i ai i latou i la le tino.

verses.en: And he also said unto him: If thou wilt turn unto me, and hearken unto my voice, and believe, and repent of all thy transgressions, and be baptized, even in water, in the name of mine Only Begotten Son, who is full of grace and truth, which is Jesus Christ, the only name which shall be given under heaven, whereby salvation shall come unto the children of men, ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost, asking all things in his name, and whatsoever ye shall ask, it shall be given you.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai foi o ia ia te ia: Afai e te liliu mai ia te a’u, ma faalogo mai i lo’u leo, ma talitonu, ma salamo i au soligatulafono uma, ma papatiso, i le vai lava, i le suafa o lo’u Atalii Pele e Toatasi, o lē ua tumu i le alofa tunoa ma le upumoni, o Iesu Keriso lea, le suafa lava lea e tasi o le a tuuina atu i lalo o le lagi, o le a oo mai ai le faaolataga i le fanauga a tagata, o le a e maua le meaalofa o le Agaga Paia, ma ole mai i mea uma i lona suafa, ma o soo se mea e te ole mai ai, o le a tuuina atu ia te oe.

verses.en: And our father Adam spake unto the Lord, and said: Why is it that men must repent and be baptized in water? And the Lord said unto Adam: Behold I have forgiven thee thy transgression in the Garden of Eden.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu lo tatou tamā o Atamu i le Alii, ua faapea atu: Aisea e tatau ai i tagata ona salamo ma papatiso i le vai? Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia Atamu: Faauta ua Ou faamagaloina oe i lau solitulafono i le Faatoaga o Etena.

verses.en: Hence came the saying abroad among the people, that the Son of God hath atoned for original guilt, wherein the sins of the parents cannot be answered upon the heads of the children, for they are whole from the foundation of the world.
verses.sm: O lea na oo mai ai le tala i totonu o le lautele o le nuu, e faapea ua togiola le Alo o le Atua mo le uluai sala, lea e lē mafai ai ona tali o agasala a matua i luga o ulu o fanau, ona ua mamā i latou mai le faavaega o le lalolagi.

w.en: from the foundation of the world,

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Adam, saying: Inasmuch as thy children are conceived in sin, even so when they begin to grow up, sin conceiveth in their hearts, and they taste the bitter, that they may know to prize the good.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia Atamu, e faapea: Talu ai ona ua fananau mai au fanau i le agasala, e faapea lava pe a amata ona latou ola a’e, ona tuputupu o le agasala i o latou loto, ma latou te tofo i le oona, ina ia latou iloa ai ona faataua le lelei.

verses.en: And it is given unto them to know good from evil; wherefore they are agents unto themselves, and I have given unto you another law and commandment.
verses.sm: Ma ua tuu atu ia te i latou ia iloa le lelei mai le leaga; o le mea lea o i latou o ni pule ia i latou lava, ma ua Ou tuu ia te oe se isi tulafono ma poloaiga.

verses.en: Wherefore teach it unto your children, that all men, everywhere, must repent, or they can in nowise inherit the kingdom of God, for no unclean thing can dwell there, or dwell in his presence; for, in the language of Adam, Man of Holiness is his name, and the name of his Only Begotten is the Son of Man, even Jesus Christ, a righteous Judge, who shall come in the meridian of time.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ia aoao atu i lau fanau, e ao i tagata uma, i soo se mea lava, ona salamo, po o o le a leai se ala e mafai ai ona latou mautofi i le malo o le Atua, ona e leai se mea lē mamā e mafai ona mau iina, pe mau i ona luma; ona, i le gagana a Atamu, o le Tagata Paia o lona suafa lea, ma o le suafa o lana Toatasi na Fanaua o le Atalii o le Tagata, o Iesu Keriso lava, o se Faamasino amiotonu, o lē o le a afio mai i le vaeluaga o taimi.

verses.en: Therefore I give unto you a commandment, to teach these things freely unto your children, saying:
verses.sm: O lea Ou te tuu atu ia te oe se poloaiga, ia aoao saoloto atu ia mea i lau fanau, ua fai atu:

verses.en: That by reason of transgression cometh the fall, which fall bringeth death, and inasmuch as ye were born into the world by water, and blood, and the spirit, which I have made, and so became of dust a living soul, even so ye must be born again into the kingdom of heaven, of water, and of the Spirit, and be cleansed by blood, even the blood of mine Only Begotten; that ye might be sanctified from all sin, and enjoy the words of eternal life in this world, and eternal life in the world to come, even immortal glory;
verses.sm: Ona o le solitulafono ua oo mai ai le pa’ū, o le pa’ū lea ua aumaia le oti, ma talu ai ona sa outou fananau mai i le lalolagi i le vai, ma le toto, ma le agaga, lea na Ou faia, ma faapea ona avea ai o le efuefu o se tagata ola, e faapea lava ona tatau ona toe fanauina o outou i le malo o le lagi, i le vai, ma i le Agaga, ma faamamaina i le toto, o le toto lava lea o la’u Toatasi na Fanaua; ina ia mafai ona faapaiaina outou mai agasala uma, ma olioli i afioga o le ola faavavau i le lalolagi lenei, ma le ola faavavau i le lalolagi a sau, o le mamalu ola pea lava;

verses.en: For by the water ye keep the commandment; by the Spirit ye are justified, and by the blood ye are sanctified;
verses.sm: Ona o le vai tou te tausia ai le poloaiga; o le Agaga e ta’uamiotonu ai outou, ma o le toto e faapaiaina ai outou;

verses.en: Therefore it is given to abide in you; the record of heaven; the Comforter; the peaceable things of immortal glory; the truth of all things; that which quickeneth all things, which maketh alive all things; that which knoweth all things, and hath all power according to wisdom, mercy, truth, justice, and judgment.
verses.sm: O lea ua tuuina atu ai e mau ia te outou; o le mau o le lagi; o le Fesoasoani; o mea filemu o le mamalu ola pea; o le upumoni o mea uma; o lē e faavaveina mea uma, lea na te faaolaina mea uma; o lē na te silafia mea uma, ma ua i ai le mana uma tau i le atamai, alofa mutimutivale, upumoni, fai mea tonu, ma le faamasinotonu.

verses.en: And now, behold, I say unto you: This is the plan of salvation unto all men, through the blood of mine Only Begotten, who shall come in the meridian of time.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te oe: O le fuafuaga o le faaolataga lenei mo tagata uma, e ala i le toto o la’u Toatasi na Fanaua, o lē o le a afio mai i le vaeluaga o taimi.

verses.en: And behold, all things have their likeness, and all things are created and made to bear record of me, both things which are temporal, and things which are spiritual; things which are in the heavens above, and things which are on the earth, and things which are in the earth, and things which are under the earth, both above and beneath: all things bear record of me.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, e i ai se faatusa o mea uma, ma ua foafoaina mea uma ma faia e molimau ia te a’u, o mea faaletino, atoa ma mea faaleagaga; o mea o i le lagi i luga, ma mea o i luga o le lalolagi, ma mea o i totonu o le lalolagi, ma mea o i lalo o le lalolagi, i luga atoa ma lalo: ua molimau mea uma ia te a’u.

w.en: of things both temporal and spiritual;

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the Lord had spoken with Adam, our father, that Adam cried unto the Lord, and he was caught away by the Spirit of the Lord, and was carried down into the water, and was laid under the water, and was brought forth out of the water.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona fetalai mai o le Alii ia Atamu, lo tatou tamā, sa tagi atu Atamu i le Alii, ma sa segia ese o ia e le Agaga o le Alii, ma sa aveina ifo o ia i lalo i totonu o le vai, ma sa faataatia i lalo o le vai, ma sa aveina a’e o ia i fafo mai le vai.

verses.en: And thus he was baptized, and the Spirit of God descended upon him, and thus he was born of the Spirit, and became quickened in the inner man.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona papatisoina o ia, ma sa afio ifo le Agaga o le Atua i luga o ia, ma sa faapea ona fanauina o ia i le Agaga, ma faaolaolaina i totonu o lona tagata.

verses.en: And he heard a voice out of heaven, saying: Thou art baptized with fire, and with the Holy Ghost. This is the record of the Father, and the Son, from henceforth and forever;
verses.sm: Ma sa faalogoina e ia se leo mai le lagi, ua fetalai mai: Ua papatisoina oe i le afi, ma le Agaga Paia. O le mau lenei a le Tamā, ma le Alo, mai le taimi nei ma le aga’i i luma ma le faavavau;

w.en: with fire and the Holy Ghost,

verses.en: And thou art after the order of him who was without beginning of days or end of years, from all eternity to all eternity.
verses.sm: Ma o oe o se tasi o le faatulagaga a ia o lē ua aunoa ma se amataga o aso po o se gataaga o tausaga, mai le vavau atoa e oo i le faavavau atoa.

verses.en: Behold, thou art one in me, a son of God; and thus may all become my sons. Amen.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua tasi oe ia te a’u, o se atalii o le Atua; ma ua faapea ona mafai ona avea tagata uma ma o’u atalii. Amene.
